title: High Wave Alert for South Gujarat Coast
description: High waves in the range of 3.2 to 4.0 meters are forecasted during 17:30 hours on 25-08-2026 to 23:30 hours on 27-08-2026 along the coast of Gujarat from Diu to Okha. Surface current speeds vary between 45 - 80 cm/sec. Fishermen are advised not to venture into sea.

title: Severe Cyclonic Storm Warning — West Central Bay of Bengal
description: Severe Cyclonic Storm moving north-northwestwards with max sustained surface wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. Heavy to very heavy rainfall expected over coastal Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha. Complete suspension of fishing operations advised.
source: IMD Cyclone Warning Division New Delhi

title: Lightning Strike Hazard Warning — Malabar Coast
description: Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and gusty winds (speed reaching 40-50 kmph) very likely over coastal Kerala (Kannur, Kozhikode, Ernakulam). Fishermen on traditional motorized crafts advised to exercise caution.

title: Storm Surge Inundation Advisory — Sundarbans Delta
description: Astronomical high tide coupled with onshore winds likely to inundate low-lying coastal areas of South 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur by 1.0 to 1.5 meters above astronomical tide.
source: INCOIS / IMD Joint Storm Surge Bulletin

title: Squally Weather Advisory — Gulf of Mannar & Comorin Area
description: Squally weather with wind speed reaching 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph likely to prevail over Gulf of Mannar, Comorin area, and south Tamil Nadu coast. Fishermen advised not to venture into these sea areas.

title: ITEWC Tsunami Watch / Normal State Bulletin
description: Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre (ITEWC) confirms normal sea level status across Indian Ocean. No tsunami threat to Indian coast following regional seismic events.
source: INCOIS Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre (ITEWC)
